invariants.rationale: The method is expected to return a non-null list of WriteStatus objects.
The clusteringGroup parameter must be non-null for clustering logic to execute.
The strategyParams map is passed along to performClusteringWithRecordList and must be non-null.
instantTime is passed to several method calls and should be non-null.
Result must be a List (of WriteStatus), as declared by the method signature.
